watched #katamarayudu – ipudosthunaaa out of box cinemalu chusi, ekkuva expect cheyakunda……story gurunchi pedhaga patijchukokundaaa…..Shruthi Hassan unnapudu kallu musukoni……patallu vachinapudu kalla tho paatu chevulu musukogaluguthe….cinema bavuntundi

2000’s lo teyalsina story line ki 1990 CG work tho tesina movie….The only saving grace for the movie is Power star supported by Ajay’s expressions and worst/irritating part is Anup Rubens Music & BGM amplified by Shruthi Hassan’s Over Expressions

Oka Rayudoooo BGM music bit thapaaa music is horrible…..manodiki inko star hero movie music kotali ante atleast 10 years wait cheyalemoo

PK okadini petesukoni……migithaaa Story, Support Cast, Music, Shruthi’s make up anni thegaaa cheapuuuu gaa santhalo konatunnaru _/\_
